subject.title: fix(channels): prevent outbound echoes and expose native login

question: Should OpenClaw publish the new core-owned `channel-outbound` identity record/query API as the permanent plugin contract, rather than keeping outbound-echo handling owner-local?
rationale: This PR adds public plugin-SDK functions and documentation, so the permanent extension boundary cannot be selected safely from patch mechanics alone.

options.title: Accept the generic SDK seam
options.body: Keep the shared registry API after confirming it is the intended cross-channel contract, while fixing Slack terminal-response capacity before merge.

options.title: Keep the behavior Discord-local
options.body: Avoid expanding the plugin SDK and retain a narrowly scoped Discord implementation until another transport demonstrates the same stable-identity need.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the shared registry API after confirming it is the intended cross-channel contract, while fixing Slack terminal-response capacity before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author has supplied the design rationale and implemented the proposed SDK boundary, but ownership confidence is limited without current-main history.
